beats.say: Your next baseball game also drops the first Avengers Doomsday preview.
A brand new preview will debut during Game One of the MLB World Series, IGN says.
Avengers: Doomsday is slated for a US release on 18 December 2026 as part of MCU Phase Six.
That means you’ll see the heroes on screen while cheering for the live home run.
Will you tune in to catch the first glimpse?
